name: FIELD-16
description: RISC-16 with its operands packed into the instruction word. The top 6 bits are the opcode, and the register numbers sit in fixed fields below it, wired to the bus through buffers of their own. The same programs assemble to fewer cells and run in fewer ticks.
tagline: RISC-16 with its operands packed into the word

programs.name: Hello, world on the LCD
programs.description: RISC-16's hello, unchanged: BL R7 and BX R7 now each fit in one word plus the address

programs.name: Fibonacci on the LCD
programs.description: ADD R0, R1, R2 is a single word: opcode, then three register fields

programs.name: Colour gradient on the screen
programs.description: Red left to right, green top to bottom

programs.name: Sketch with the arrow keys
programs.description: Reads the keypad once with IN R0 and tests each key with ANDI R4, R0, n
